first_failures.detail: Resizing replaced the selected 400x241 crop with the original 1000x600 image.
AppKit disables its native zoom widget when native resizing is removed. A same-location Legacy zoom/restore control now preserves the action.
On CI macOS 15 and 26, a throttled initial timer could run after the website opened history. Already-collapsed state is now recorded in the first recognized layout.
All three CI hosts passed 13/14 UI scenarios, but keypad Enter did not produce the second image. AppKit character normalization and bounded offline key/phase diagnostics added; fresh CI required.

packaged_xctest.reason: CLT only; preserved the user QA042 instance and global shortcuts.

ci.reason: Keypad Enter case failed on all three hosts; native initial-collapse race also failed on 15 and 26. No retries of unchanged code.
